assertions.description: port is a readonly accessor: a getter with no setter on AudioWorklet.prototype.
On a real OfflineAudioContext, audioWorklet.port is a MessagePort instance.
assertions.test: (()=>{if(typeof AudioWorklet!=='function'||!('port' in AudioWorklet.prototype))return false;const ctx=new OfflineAudioContext(1,128,48000);return ctx.audioWorklet.port instanceof MessagePort;})()

assertions.description: Reading audioWorklet.port twice on the same context yields the same MessagePort object ([SameObject]).
assertions.test: (()=>{if(typeof AudioWorklet!=='function'||!('port' in AudioWorklet.prototype))return false;const ctx=new OfflineAudioContext(1,128,48000);return ctx.audioWorklet.port===ctx.audioWorklet.port;})()

assertions.description: A message posted on audioWorklet.port is answered by a handler registered on the AudioWorkletGlobalScope's port global — a full main-thread/rendering-thread round-trip with no processor involved.
assertions.test: (async()=>{if(typeof AudioWorklet!=='function'||!('port' in AudioWorklet.prototype))return false;const ctx=new OfflineAudioContext(1,128,48000);const mod='if(typeof port!=="undefined"&&port){port.onmessage=(e)=>port.postMessage({echo:e.data,scope:"AudioWorkletGlobalScope"});}registerProcessor("cf-noop",class extends AudioWorkletProcessor{process(){return false;}});';const url=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([mod],{type:'text/javascript'}));try{await ctx.audioWorklet.addModule(url);const p=ctx.audioWorklet.port;if(!(p instanceof MessagePort))return false;const reply=await new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const t=setTimeout(()=>reject(new Error('no reply within 3s')),3000);p.onmessage=(e)=>{clearTimeout(t);resolve(e.data);};p.postMessage('ping');});return reply&&reply.echo==='ping'&&reply.scope==='AudioWorkletGlobalScope';}finally{URL.revokeObjectURL(url);}})()
